generations.zh: 当前代旗舰。官方模型卡：1T 总参、49B 激活（含嵌入输出 52B），128 路由专家 + 1 共享专家，1M 上下文，文本 + 图像输入；3,800 张 Grace Blackwell 训练。许可为 Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight License（修改版 MIT，MaaS 需单独商业许可）。
generations.en: Current flagship. Official model card: 1T total, 49B active (52B including embeddings and output), 128 routed experts plus 1 shared, 1M context, text + image input; trained on 3,800 Grace Blackwell GPUs. Licensed under the Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight License (modified MIT; MaaS requires a separate commercial licence).

generations.zh: 当前代开源杯：119B MoE（每 token 激活 6.5B）、256k 上下文、多模态输入、Apache-2.0。
generations.en: Current open tier: 119B MoE (6.5B activated per token), 256k context, multimodal input, Apache-2.0.

generations.zh: 当前代旗舰（非开源杯）：官方定位「first flagship merged model」，密集 128B、256k 上下文，Modified MIT 许可。
generations.en: Current flagship tier: officially positioned as the "first flagship merged model", dense 128B with 256k context, under a Modified MIT licence.

generations.zh: 上一代开源杯 24B，官方口径延迟比 3.1 降 40%。
generations.en: Previous open tier at 24B; officially 40% lower latency than 3.1.

generations.zh: 推理线（ Magistral Small/Medium ），Medium 3.5 官方文档说它在 Le Chat 里被 3.5 取代。
generations.en: The reasoning line (Magistral Small/Medium); per the official Medium 3.5 documentation, it is superseded by 3.5 in Le Chat.

sizeTiers.zh: 旗舰档：1.05T 总参 / 49B 激活（含嵌入输出 52B）
sizeTiers.en: Flagship tier: 1.05T total / 49B active (52B including embeddings and output)
Small 24B-119B (MoE): the locally runnable open tier

licenses.zh: Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight License（修改版 MIT；MaaS 需单独商业许可）
licenses.en: Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight License (modified MIT; separate commercial licence for MaaS)

licenses.zh: Modified MIT（Medium 3.5；对高营收公司有例外条款，LICENSE 原文在模型仓）
licenses.en: Modified MIT (Medium 3.5; exceptions for large-revenue companies, full LICENSE text in the repo)

claims.zh: 官方模型卡：「a 1 trillion-parameter natively multimodal Mixture-of-Experts model with 49 billion active parameters per token (52 billion including embeddings and output layers)」——1T 总参、49B 激活、原生多模态 MoE；3,800 张 Grace Blackwell 训练。
claims.en: Official model card: "a 1 trillion-parameter natively multimodal Mixture-of-Experts model with 49 billion active parameters per token (52 billion including embeddings and output layers)" — 1T total, 49B active, natively multimodal MoE; trained on 3,800 Grace Blackwell GPUs.

claims.zh: 官方模型卡：128 路由专家、每 token 激活 4 个 + 1 共享专家；1M 上下文；160+ 语言；文本 + 图像输入。
claims.en: Official model card: 128 routed experts, 4 active per token plus 1 shared; 1M context; 160+ languages; text + image input.

claims.zh: 官方模型卡：Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index 48%，与 GLM-5.3 基本持平，每任务少 47% token；AA Intelligence Index v5 得分 26。第三方指数，不是本站实测。
claims.en: Official model card: 48% on the Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index, effectively tied with GLM-5.3 while using 47% fewer tokens per task; AA Intelligence Index v5 score 26. Third-party indices, not measured here.

claims.zh: 官方 README（Small 4）：「119B parameters, with 6.5B activated per token」+「256k context length」+ 128 experts / 4 active 的 MoE 结构。
claims.en: Official README (Small 4): "119B parameters, with 6.5B activated per token", "256k context length", MoE with 128 experts and 4 active.

claims.zh: 官方 README（Medium 3.5）：「a dense 128B model with a 256k context window」，指令遵循、推理、编码合一；取代 Medium 3.1 与 Magistral。
claims.en: Official README (Medium 3.5): "a dense 128B model with a 256k context window", unifying instruction-following, reasoning and coding; supersedes Medium 3.1 and Magistral.

positioning.zh: 欧洲开放权重旗舰：1T 级 MoE + 1M 上下文 + 视觉输入，许可为修改版 MIT（MaaS 需单独授权）。适合需要「开放权重 + 欧洲合规叙事 + 多语言」的部署者；本地运行门槛极高，官方提供 NVFP4 量化档与 DSpark 投机解码草稿头。
positioning.en: A European open-weight flagship: 1T-class MoE, 1M context and vision input, under a modified MIT licence (separate MaaS grant needed). For deployers who need open weights, a European compliance story and multilingual coverage; local hosting is extremely demanding, and the official release includes an NVFP4 checkpoint and a DSpark speculative-decoding draft head.

onSite.zh: 本站未收录 Mistral 系列的量化对比：Mistral-Small-4-119B 的第三方 GGUF 下载量约 8.4 万（2026-10-30 复测），未过 METHODOLOGY 的量化生态门槛（约 30 万）。
onSite.en: This site does not cover Mistral quantisations: Mistral-Small-4-119B's third-party GGUF downloads (~84k, re-measured 2026-10-30) fall below the METHODOLOGY ecosystem threshold (~300k).
